categories.name: International Relations
categories.definition: News concerning diplomatic relations, foreign policy, international agreements, and global cooperation or conflict between countries or international bodies.

categories.name: Economy & Business

categories.name: Technology

categories.name: Entertainment

categories.name: Social Issues

categories.name: Law & Justice
